Reading 899OK Odds

Two odds formats on 899OK: Decimal (default) — what you get back per ৳1 stake (1.50 → ৳150 back, 2.00 → ৳200 back, 5.00 → ৳500 back). Fractional — UK style, 3/1 means ৳3 profit per ৳1 stake plus stake back.
